notes: US name 'motorola razr+ 2024'; EU/global name 'Razr 50 Ultra' - one physical device. PAIRING VERIFIED: the US page (device field 'motorola razr+ 2024') and the UK page (device field 'motorola razr 50 ultra') publish byte-identical geometry - open 73.99 x 171.42 x 7.09 mm, closed 73.99 x 88.09 x 15.32 mm, 189 g, 6.9in/4.0in displays, 2640x1080 / 1272x1080, same Gorilla Glass Victus + vegan leather + 6000-series aluminium body - and the US page serves image assets named 'razr-50-plus-*'. Both URLs are cited. Dimensions printed W x H x D; 73.99 mapped to width. The US quote reproduces Motorola's own typo ('88.09x 15.32mm', missing space) verbatim; the GB page prints it correctly. displays[0].aspect null - Motorola prints only 'Main display: 22:9' on this page. hinge.crease / hinge.free_stop null: neither 'teardrop' nor 'Flex View' appears as page content on the 2024 pages (unlike the 2023 razr+ page). No 'titanium-reinforced hinge' claim appears on either page, so no titanium is recorded. announced/released null: no reachable manufacturer press release. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence).
